attempts.label: numbers-1-cu
reasons: Reviewed all 30 recorded calls, final DONE and initial context; fresh profile/cwd with no AGENTS injection. EXCLUDED because call 20 omitted the supplied helper and used globally installed cu for sdef Numbers. That binary SHA-256 49ca2e3d9bf1b9dc7a3ae66e140b38d25154911beef480c763951d729616fbcc differs from frozen candidate f7f6f64e0dd27c25e2d113bb2da3a91800efc25858af29018f96ad980afb88d0; it started default Broker 44797. The deviation was read-only dictionary discovery, not a document edit; all other cu commands used the assigned runtime. Saved artifact at the requested path independently passed all checks, including reopen and quantity/price changes recalculating every formula. Script-scope error occurred after edits; participant read back before continuing. Recovery made redundant saves/observations, one save timeout, invalid export attempts and duplicate task documents. Document properties continued to point to an iCloud copy even though save-in created the requested local file; this is a confusing save-copy identity distinction, not evidence the requested file was absent. No direct document file IO or settings change occurred. Owned Numbers process and task Broker stopped; accidental default Broker was also stopped after the run. This artifact success and DONE are retained, but excluded from compliant success and completion-claim rate calculations. Although Numbers started in an owned process, macOS restored three prior benchmark document windows. State output exposed their window titles; the participant did not select or read their contents. This is an additional application-state isolation limitation, not a fully fresh app session.
